cookieConsent.description: ဝဘ်ဆိုက် အလုပ်လုပ်စေရန် မရှိမဖြစ်လိုအပ်သော ကွတ်ကီးများကို အသုံးပြုပါသည်။ သင်၏ သဘောတူညီချက်ဖြင့် ဧည့်သည်များ ဝဘ်ဆိုက်ကို မည်သို့အသုံးပြုသည်ကို နားလည်ရန် ခွဲခြမ်းစိတ်ဖြာရေး ကွတ်ကီးများ (Google Analytics) နှင့် ကျွန်ုပ်တို့၏ ကြော်ငြာများကို တိုင်းတာရန် စျေးကွက်ရှာဖွေရေး ကွတ်ကီးများ (Meta Pixel) ကိုလည်း အသုံးပြုပါသည်။ ကျွန်ုပ်တို့၏ <link>ကိုယ်ရေးအချက်အလက်မူဝါဒ</link>ကို ကြည့်ပါ။

about.heroTitle: Guiding your journey from ambition to world-class education.
about.storyTitle: Built by veteran advisors who believe students deserve the truth.
about.storyBody1: For over a decade, we watched students across Asia get steered toward partner universities that served agency commissions rather than student futures.
about.storyBody2: Saturday Education was founded to change that. We provide independent, certified guidance where every recommendation is chosen strictly for your academic capability, budget, and career goals, with zero hidden incentives.
about.value1Desc: Zero hidden fees, zero university kickbacks. Full disclosure of tuition costs, admission criteria, and visa requirements upfront.
about.value2Desc: Recommendations mapped strictly to your strengths, budget, and long-term career goals, without agency commission bias.
about.value3Desc: Decades of combined counseling experience with official certifications across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe.
about.value4Desc: Dedicated guidance continuing past your offer letter, through visa filing, pre-departure prep, arrival, and campus settlement.
about.teamTitle: The experienced team behind every student outcome.
about.teamSubtitle: Real counsellors with verifiable track records and direct involvement in your application strategy.
about.team1Bio: Leads Saturday Education's vision and strategy, building the partnerships that open doors for students across Asia to study abroad with confidence.
about.team2Bio: Guides operational planning, student support coordination, and internal processes to help Saturday Education Consulting deliver consistent and reliable education consulting services.
about.team3Bio: Guides students through applications and admissions, turning paperwork and deadlines into a clear, stress-free path to their dream university.
about.why1Desc: Navigating rigorous country-specific criteria and documentation with verified expert guidance.
about.why2Desc: Transparent financial planning and course matching tailored to individual academic goals.
about.why3Desc: Dedicated advisors who stay personally engaged from initial consultation through university arrival.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to discuss your study abroad pathway?
about.ctaSubtitle: Book a 1-on-1 session with our certified advisors in Yangon, Bangkok, or online.
about.heroCaption: Saturday Education team warmly welcomes you.
about.storyImageAlt: David Dhakal leading counsellor training at Saturday Education
about.cert_usatc: USATC Graduate, U.S. Agent Training Course
about.cert_icef: Advising for Study in France (ASF), ICEF Academy
about.cert_mcmf: Career Counsellor Certification (MCMF), Pearson Academy India
about.reviewBody: Our leaders and counsellors meet daily to review complex admission profiles, scholarship portfolios, and visa files. You gain the combined insight of our entire leadership team rather than leaving decisions to a single point of failure.
